_meta.description: Regex-based mapping for CSS selectors and imports (Structural Heuristics).

class_selector._doc: The lookahead accepts every selector-terminator so a class is captured regardless of what follows it: whitespace/comma/brace/pseudo (:) PLUS a compound (.a.b -> a AND b), child (>), sibling (+ ~), and attribute ([) — the first class of a compound selector was previously missed. The name still requires a letter/_/- start, so a numeric value (.5em) never matches.

animations._doc: CSS coverage P2. @keyframes NAME { body } -> a Keyframes node (with a normalized body_hash for identical-duplicate detection) + a defines edge; an animation:/animation-name: NAME declaration -> a uses_animation edge (Stylesheet -> Keyframes NAME, joined by name). The @keyframes blocks are stripped before selector matching so their to/from/percent stops don't leak into StyleElement. Empty/absent = off (the old 'Animations unmodeled' ambiguity is kept).
